Hi Alex —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation kickoff: 

- Goal: Validate CardioMed’s triage assistant for intake notes and clinical summaries (target: 85% precision on diagnosis suggestions; latency target < 300ms p50).
- Scope for initial 14-day trial: indexing of 2000 historical notes, prompt pack of ~50 scenarios, and integration test with a non-prod S3 bucket (anonymized).
- Success criteria: quality gates on the prompt set, inference cost baseline, and a joint runbook for failover.

Could we lock a 60-min evaluation kickoff (trial plan + success criteria + prompt inventory walkthrough)? Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 3 May, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 4 May, 09:00–10:00 PT

If those don't work, send two times that suit your engineering and product leads. Also: please share the names/emails of technical attendees, and any sample prompts/data we should prepare in advance.

I’ll follow up with a lightweight trial-charter doc and an SOW stub once we’ve pinned a time.
